cohort: 382 gravid females in active labor (>= 2 uterine contractions in 10 min) and their neonates.
finding: Babies with low birth weight had significantly lower maternal mean serum zinc levels compared to babies with normal birth weight, indicating a significant positive linear relationship between maternal zinc consumption and infant birth weight.
birth_weight: Neonates were categorized as low birth weight (LBW) or average/normal birth weight.
